description: How to find companies with genuine women's rights commitments
note: We direct to verified public registries rather than naming specific companies. This ensures accuracy and legal safety.

certified_equal_pay.description: Companies with verified equal pay certification
certified_equal_pay.how_to_find: Equal Pay International Coalition (EPIC) employer register: equalpayinternationalcoalition.org/employer-recognition
certified_equal_pay.examples: See EPIC registry. Iceland-certified companies listed at jafnlaunavottun.is. UK Gender Pay Gap data: gender-pay-gap.service.gov.uk
certified_equal_pay.partner_for: Pay equity benchmarking, policy advocacy, employee recruitment

iloBetterWork.description: Companies enrolled in ILO Better Work programme
iloBetterWork.how_to_find: ILO Better Work buyer partners publicly listed: betterwork.org/our-work/buyers
iloBetterWork.examples: Full list at betterwork.org. These companies have committed to factory-level gender audits in garment supply chains.
iloBetterWork.partner_for: Garment sector sourcing, worker welfare programs, supply chain due diligence

b_corp_gender_lens.description: B Corp certified companies with gender lens investing focus
b_corp_gender_lens.how_to_find: B Corp directory with gender filter: bcorporation.net/en-us/find-a-b-corp Filter by: Community → Diversity, Equity + Inclusion
b_corp_gender_lens.examples: Search B Corp directory. 6,000+ certified companies globally. Filter by country and sector relevant to your partnership.
b_corp_gender_lens.partner_for: Social enterprise partnerships, impact investing, supply chain partners with verified social standards

2x_challenge.description: Companies backed by 2X Challenge gender lens investors
2x_challenge.examples: Development finance-backed companies with women's ownership/leadership/employment criteria verified.
2x_challenge.partner_for: Investment partnerships, market access, enterprise development in emerging markets

weps_signatories.how_to_find: WEPs signatory database: weps.org/signatories Search by country and sector
weps_signatories.examples: 3,000+ companies have signed the UN Women's Empowerment Principles. Covers: workplace gender equality, community engagement, marketplace transparency.
weps_signatories.partner_for: Corporate partnership, co-branding, supply chain relationships, investor relations

genderSmart_investors.description: Gender-lens investors actively funding women's initiatives
genderSmart_investors.examples: Verified gender-lens investors across asset classes. Useful for: funding women's programs, ESG investment partnerships.
genderSmart_investors.partner_for: Funding, ESG alignment, impact measurement partnerships
